name: Flicka Silk Touch Concentrate | 3-in-1 | Primer, Moisturizer & Sunscreen
description:
Flicka Silk Touch Concentrate is a multi-purpose 3-in-1 formula designed to moisturize, prime, and protect your skin in one simple step. Its lightweight milk-cream texture melts into the skin, delivering deep hydration while creating a smooth, pore-blurred base for makeup. Non-greasy and fast-absorbing, it enhances makeup longevity and leaves your skin soft, silky, and naturally radiant all day.Key Features:

3-in-1 moisturiser, primer, and sunscreen

Smooths skin and blurs the appearance of pores

Lightweight, non-sticky milk-cream texture

Deep hydration with a silky finish

Helps makeup last longer and look flawless

Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin

How to Use:
1⃣ Take a small amount on fingertips
2⃣ Apply evenly on clean, dry skin
3⃣ Gently massage until fully absorbed
4⃣ Use alone for natural glow or before foundation as primerIngredients:
Shea Butter, Vitamin E, Aloe Vera, Vitamin C, Coconut MilkSafety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Store in a cool, dry placePackage Includes:
 1 × Flicka Silk Touch Concentrate
